name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; accurately describes loading all per-chapter battle data and building runtime_char_array. No Ghidra address residue. Matches actual behavior verified in decompilation and all three callers (fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter, fd2_chapter_30_end, fd2_play_final_chapter_30_ending).
purpose: CRITICAL chapter init: loads every per-chapter battle resource (text, tile map, tile-event table, portrait table, scene snapshot, tile-attribute flags) from packed DAT files and builds the runtime_char_array of player units for the upcoming battle.
logic_summary: 1) fd2_load_chapter_background_layers(). 2) FDTXT.DAT[chapter_id+1] -> data_fd2_current_chapter_text. 3) FDFIELD.DAT[chapter_id*3 +2/+1/+0] -> chapter_portrait_load_buffer / tile_event_data_table / battle_tile_map. 4) map width/height = first two int16 of battle_tile_map. 5) scene_id = tile_event_data_table[0]; FDSHAP.DAT[scene_id*2] -> battle_scene_snapshot, FDSHAP.DAT[scene_id*2+1] -> tile_attribute_flags_buffer. 6) fd2_obfuscate_battle_tile_map(battle_tile_map). 7) portrait_cache_total_size = tile_event[1], portrait_cache_alloc_offset = tile_event[2], party_member_count = portrait_cache_total_size. 8) free old portrait_sprite_cache + old runtime_char_array. 9) malloc 0x1E00 (96 chars x 0x50) for runtime_char_array. 10) fopen FDICON.B24 'rb'. 11) loop char_iter 0..portrait_cache_total_size: empty-slot test ((chapter<0xd && slot==6 && roster_template[8]!=2) || active_count>=menu_party_member_count) -> zero 0x50 bytes + flags=1 (dead); else copy 0x50-byte roster template, set pos_x/pos_y from FDFIELD position table (6-byte stride from alloc_offset, +2 header skip), load portrait sprite via fd2_load_portrait_to_cache -> sprite_state[0], zero sprite_state[1..2], team=2 (player), combat_aux_block[10]=0xff, zero status_flags_block[1..6], fd2_recalculate_combat_stats(char_iter), advance template_ptr, active_count++. 12) fclose; free+NULL chapter_portrait_load_buffer. 13) fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(0). malloc/fopen failure -> INT 10h text reset + printf + exit(1). Normal tail falls through into shared epilogue fragment fd2_noop_stub_b43 @ 0x10b43.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Chapter id (1-30). Index into per-chapter resource tables: FDTXT.DAT[chapter+1], FDFIELD.DAT[chapter*3+0/1/2]. Also gates the empty-slot rule (chapter<0xd reserves slot 6 unless roster template flag==2). Caller fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter passes data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id.
params.reason: Ghidra live parameter is the generic placeholder param_1; src/ home file already uses descriptive name chapter_id. Stage 2 should rename the Ghidra parameter to chapter_id to match the source declaration and proto. Domain id 1-30, not an address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects: populates runtime_char_array and many battle globals; on malloc/fopen failure resets text mode and exit(1) (does not return).

comment_original_issue: src/ block comment was already accurate, concise and ASCII; step 5 correctly attributes the FDSHAP index to tile_event[0]. No factual issue in src. (The Ghidra plate, by contrast, mis-stated step 5 as FDSHAP.DAT[tile_map[0]*2]; the index actually derives from tile_event_data_table[0]. Plate corrected.)
notes: Source block comment kept verbatim (already correct). Param name param_1 (Ghidra) -> proposed chapter_id for Stage 2 to sync with source/proto.
